checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire image neutral B&W, no red or colour
must.why: Appears fully greyscale; car is grey.

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged details
must.why: Car shape, position, wheels, lights match; plate is slightly altered but minor.

must.item: Street and background retain positions and appearance apart from colour
must.why: Layout and objects are the same; the red car in the background is now grey and tonal values are slightly different.

faults.what: The car's tonal rendering is a bit flat and mid-grey. The red paint became a light grey with less contrast than a straight desaturation would give.
The plate and small details are slightly redrawn, as expected for an AI redraw.

summary: A faithful, uncropped black-and-white version of the photo with the composition and car intact; only minor tonal and fine-detail differences.
